name: FFS_ACTIVITY_LINK_TYPE
description: Stores predefined named templates of activity links.

columns.name: TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the activity link type.

columns.name: REGULAR_LABEL
columns.description: It is a regular label of the type. The type labels are unique inside of the same company.

columns.name: REVERSE_LABEL
columns.description: It is a reverse label of the type. The type labels are unique inside of the same company.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: This parameter defines activity link type status .

columns.name: SEQUENCE
columns.description: Activity link type sequence of actions.

columns.name: MIN_INTERVAL
columns.description: This parameter defines if the minimum time delay is required for activity links of this type.

columns.name: MIN_INTERVAL_VALUE
columns.description: This parameter contains a predefined value of the minimum time delay that is populated if min_interval = non_adjustable.

columns.name: MAX_INTERVAL
columns.description: This parameter defines if the maximum time delay is required for activity links of this type.

columns.name: MAX_INTERVAL_VALUE
columns.description: This parameter contains a predefined value of the maximum time delay that is populated if max_interval = non_adjustable.

columns.name: SCHEDULING
columns.description: It defines a restriction on a date selection.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT
columns.description: It defines a restriction on a resource selection.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is logically deleted (Y - soft deleted, N or NULL - active).
